Three products. One architecture.
 
Empowering every team — from first signal to activation
 
Each product stands alone. Together, they form the complete customer context platform. One engine, zero syncing, no ETL between products.
 
 
 
 
Capture & Resolve
 
↓
 
 
→
 
 
Profile & Segment
 
↓
 
 
→
 
 
Activate & Engage
 
 
 
 
 
 
CDI
 
For data engineering & product teams
 
Meiro Pipes
 
The agentic data control plane
 
 
Capture behavioral data from every touchpoint, resolve identity in real time, and route it anywhere. Your warehouse, your analytics, your activation tools. AI agents handle schema mapping, debugging, and setup. Zero data egress. Deploy anywhere.
 
 
184ms identity resolution
 
Zero data egress
 
AI-assisted schema mapping & ops
 
Self-hosted, any cloud, or managed
 
 
Explore Pipes →
 
 
 
 
CDP
 
For marketing & growth teams
 
Meiro Audiences
 
The persistent customer profile engine
 
 
One customer. One truth. Audiences builds the persistent, complex customer profile — a continuously updated single view of every customer, with consent governance and powerful audience segmentation.
 
 
Persistent single customer view
 
Consent governance built-in
 
AI-powered audience segmentation
 
Trusted by AI agents, queryable in real time
 
 
Explore Audiences →
 
 
 
 
CEP
 
For marketing & growth teams
 
Meiro Engage
 
Turn customer context into action
 
 
Engage activates unified profiles across email, push, SMS, advertising, and more so the right message reaches the right customer at the right moment. The activation layer where unified knowledge becomes personalized action.
 
 
Email, push, SMS, paid media
 
Journey orchestration with AI
 
Agent-triggered actions
 
No message volume limits
 
 
Explore Engage →
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
For marketing teams
 
Agentic marketing that runs on customer context.
 
Your team has the ideas. Piper, Meiro's AI agent, finds the right audience, writes the content, sets up the journey, and executes across every channel. You stay focused on strategy.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Know who's ready to buy, right now
 
 
 
Spot high-intent moments the instant they happen. Audiences built on live behavior, with identity resolved across sessions and devices, refreshing in real time as your customers move.
 
Learn more →
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Journeys that react, not just schedule
 
 
 
Build flows that branch on real signals: a cart abandoned, a loyalty tier reached, a product browsed twice. No static drip campaigns. Journeys that adapt to what customers actually do.
 
Learn more →
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Every message feels written for that one person
 
 
 
Pull any resolved attribute, lifetime value, last category, predicted churn, directly into email, SMS, or push. Not basic mail merge. The kind of personalization that makes customers feel genuinely known.
 
Learn more →
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
First-party audiences that outperform cookie lists
 
 
 
First-party resolved profiles match to Meta, Google, and TikTok far better than cookie-based lists. Enterprise clients consistently see meaningful lifts in match rates and return on ad spend.
 
Learn more →

For engineering & data teams
 
Meiro runs on your own infrastructure or in cloud. 
Your data, your choice.
 
 
Meiro Pipes is the CDI at the heart of Meiro: a real-time data control plane that captures events, resolves identity, and routes customer data wherever it needs to go. No egress. No lock-in.
 
 
 
Powered by
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Private deployment model
 
Deploy Meiro anywhere in the world. Choose on-premise infrastructure or bring your own cloud for total control over your data and compliance with any security requirement.
 
Learn more →
 
 
 
 
 
 
Composable with your data warehouse
 
Unlike tools that only query warehouse data, Meiro lets you keep and orchestrate all customer data functions directly within your DWH, without ever exporting data outside.
 
Learn more →
 
 
 
 
 
 
Real-time identity resolution
 
Set your own identifier types, priority rules, and merge logic. Profiles update in under a second and reach every connected channel.
 
Learn more →
 
 
 
 
Explore Pipes demo →

From first browse to personalized offer in seconds.

Why Meiro wins
 
No other platform combines all four of these
 
Deploy anywhere. Full loop. AI-native operations. Pricing that doesn't punish growth.
 
 
 
 
01
 
 
 
Deploy anywhere
 
Self-hosted on your cloud, Meiro-managed on any cloud in any region, or fully managed SaaS. Your customer data stays where your compliance, security, and AI strategy need it to be.
 
 
 
02
 
 
 
The full loop
 
Pipes captures and resolves. Audiences profiles and segments. Engage activates. One platform, from signal to action. No need to stitch together five vendors.
 
 
 
03
 
 
 
Warehouse-composable
 
Works with Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks natively, or runs fully independently. You don't need a data warehouse to get started.
 
 
 
04
 
 
 
Pricing that doesn't punish growth
 
No MTU traps. Predictable costs with typical savings of 60-80% vs. Segment or RudderStack at scale. As your customer base grows, your costs don't explode.

CDP FOR PERSONALIZED EMAIL MARKETING
 
Engage Customers with Personalized Emails
 
Leverage unified customer data from all touchpoints, CRM, and data warehouse to activate precise audience segments with hyper-personalized, engaging email campaigns—no IT or data analysts needed. Seamlessly integrate your existing email platform with our Customer Data Platform or use Meiro's native Email channel.
 
 
Talk to sales
 
Interactive demo
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Tried & trusted by clients worldwide
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Proven Impact
 
Trusted results at scale
 
 
 
 
+260%
 
Increase in conversion rates
 
 
+20%
 
Increase in customer lifetime value (CLV)
 
 
+72%
 
Increase in average order value
 
 
+50%
 
Higher customer engagement
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
HEADLESS PERSONALIZATION API
 
Grow CLV with AI-driven personalization
 
Create hyper-personalized email campaigns at scale with unified real-time and historical data, enriched customer attributes, AI-driven insights and predictions. Easily build audience segments, apply recommendations, and deliver timely and relevant messages that nurture loyalty.
 
Learn more about Recommendation Models 
→
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
NATIVE CUSTOMER JOURNEY BUILDER
 
Drive revenues through personalized email automation
 
Automate multi-step email journeys, like abandoned cart recovery or cross-sell, triggered by real-time customer behavior, preferences, and events. Run A/B tests, optimize content, and leverage AI to refine delivery timing and strategy for maximum conversions.
 
Learn more about Customer Journey Orchestration 
→
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
BUILT-IN EMAIL MARKETING CHANNEL
 
Design & send personalized emails with ease
 
Design responsive email templates in minutes with the native drag-and-drop editor or use HTML builder. Personalize your campaigns with dynamic content, tailoring each email to unique preferences of your customers. With our built-in Email Channel, you can streamline your workflow and manage campaigns seamlessly within Meiro CDP interface.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
UNPARALLELED FLEXIBILITY
 
Integrate with your preferred email provider
 
To guarantee convenience and unparalleled flexibility, our email solution enables you to integrate with the email sending provider of your choosing when using Meiro's native email marketing feature.

What's unique about Meiro Customer Data & Experience Platform
 
 
 
 
Accelerated data integration
 
Unlike most CDPs, Meiro automates data normalization, cleaning, and enrichment, letting you ingest unstructured data in real-time and batch with native Reverse ETL, cutting implementation time and dependency on internal resources.
 
Learn more about Data Management →
 
 
Best-in-class identity resolution
 
Meiro combines machine learning with deterministic and probabilistic methods to create comprehensive customer profiles across devices, browsers, and touchpoints—both online and offline—in real-time, leading to enhanced targeting, personalization, and campaign performance.
 
Learn more about Single Customer View →
 
 
No-code segmentation & campaign orchestration
 
Empowering marketers to build micro-audience segments without IT support, then craft, launch, and optimize multi-step omnichannel experiences—synchronizing targeting across advertising platforms and orchestrating campaigns across all owned channels.
 
Learn more about Smart Segmentation →
 
 
Headless personalization across devices
 
Unlike most personalization techniques that rely on real-time data, Meiro empowers your web and mobile app CMS to deliver AI-driven, headless personalization, leveraging rich historical customer insights stored in the CDP—enhancing experiences and driving customer lifetime value (CLV).
 
Learn more about Personalization →
 
 
Ultimate composability
 
Agile, scalable, and highly flexible, Meiro integrates seamlessly with your MarTech stack and data infrastructure, allowing you to choose only the CDP components you need. Meiro keeps your data securely within your data warehouse, reducing hidden costs and ensuring full control over your customer data.
 
 
Deployed anywhere
 
For full control over data and tech stack, Meiro enables IT teams to integrate their own security standards and tools and delivers private deployments across all major clouds and on-premise. Even as a managed service, Meiro supports deployments in over 100 countries, ensuring local data residency compliance.
 
Learn more about Deployment Options →

Newsroom
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Transparent pricing.
 
No growth tax.
 
 
Volume-based pricing that scales with your data, not against it. No per-seat fees. No MTU traps. No hidden costs buried in small feature add-ons. You only pay for the modules you need.
 
 
Try Pipes For Free
 
Contact Us
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Pricing philosophy
 
Designed for teams who hate billing surprises.
 
Most CDI / CDP vendors start cheap and get expensive fast. MTU-based models tax every new customer you acquire. Small feature add-ons inflate your contract at renewal. We designed a pricing model that rewards your growth instead of penalizing it.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Volume-based, not MTU-based
 
You pay for events processed, not "monthly tracked users." No surprise bills when your user base grows. Predictable costs at any scale.
 
 
 
 
 
Pay for the modules you need
 
Each module is a meaningful set of functionality — not a nickel-and-dime feature gate. You keep what works in your current stack.
 
 
 
 
 
Same features, any deployment
 
Whether you run on Meiro-hosted cloud, your own private cloud, or fully on-prem — the feature set is identical. Deployment customisation is available as an optional upgrade.
 
 
 
 
 
Soft bands, not hard walls
 
Seasonal traffic spikes won't trigger overages or shut anything down. We only revisit your tier if sustained usage consistently exceeds your band.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
What changes
 
The pricing traps we eliminated.
 
 
 
 
 
Legacy model
 
 
 
Meiro
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
MTU-based pricing
 
Penalizes growth. A tax on every new user your product acquires.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Event volume pricing
 
Pay for data processed. Your cost per user drops as you scale.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Hidden feature add-ons
 
Small features sold as separate line items that inflate your contract at every renewal.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Meaningful modules
 
Each module is a complete set of functionality. No additional tools or hidden costs within them.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Per-seat fees
 
Charging per user means you pay more to give your own team proper access.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Unlimited seats
 
Your whole team gets access. No friction for collaboration or onboarding.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Surprise overages
 
Hard usage caps that trigger bills the moment you exceed a threshold.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Tiered licencing, soft bands
 
Seasonal spikes allowed — no interruption. Review only if sustained overuse occurs.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Growth tax
 
The more successful your business is, the more you pay — pricing that punishes your own traction.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Smooth tier progression
 
No cliff-edge jumps between plans. Tiers scale gradually with your volume — you won't get hit with a massive price increase just because you outgrew a threshold.
 
 
 
 
 
50–80%
 
 
Organisations switching to Meiro typically cut legacy vendor costs by 50–80%
 
More capability, sovereign deployment, unlimited users — at a fraction of what you're paying today.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Flexibility
 
Start with what you need. Expand when you're ready.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Product scope
 
Start with Pipes or Audiences as standalone products, add Engage for activation, or deploy the full platform under one unified architecture. Each product is priced independently and can be expanded later.
 
 
Pipes
 
Audiences
 
Engage
 
 
 
 
 
 
Enterprise requirements
 
Premium SLA, multi-region deployment, premium support, SSO, audit logging, advanced governance, and compliance features are included in enterprise contracts — not upsells.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Tiers
 
Pre-defined tiers. Predictable costs.
 
Annual subscription with monthly usage thresholds. Pick the tier that fits your volume — upgrade when your needs change.
 
 
 
 
Tier 1
 
Start
 
For teams getting started with their customer data stack. Lower event volumes, standard support, Meiro-hosted deployment.
 
 
Contact Us
 
 
 
Tier 2
 
Pro
 
For growing organisations with production workloads. Higher event thresholds, additional deployment options, and dedicated support.
 
 
Contact Us
 
 
 
Tier 3
 
Enterprise
 
For organisations with sovereign requirements, large-scale data operations, and complex multi-region infrastructure needs.
